evidence: Matches the 'Wallet' label and modifies wallet database records and logic across `src/wallet/`.
rationale: This PR records client feature capabilities in wallet metadata so future upgrades can safely detect downgrade scenarios without requiring full rescans on every load. As noted in the description, 'When a wallet is opened in an older release after being upgraded and then returned to a newer release, it can accumulate mixed upgraded and un-upgraded data', making this a necessary prerequisite for subsequent automated wallet upgrade work.
